Behold, this worn yet even glow of memory,
Plunging with a "plunk" through the crimson clouds.
The evening bell summons recollections from the grave,
Turning to white doves—weightless now, no longer burning.
And I wait, for its tireless, infinite returns.

Circling, wings spread toward rosy-fingered dawn,
Striding, leaping, sailing to the wine-dark sea.
Clutch the helm, raise your voice in song,
Till sirens climb your blade,
Summoning the first dream that stings you.

Thieves on the train.
You rarely see them, but they always manage to find you.

Insidious robbers.
There are many kinds of scoundrels, but even among true ruffians, those who take advantage of others' kindness are treated with great disdain.

A researcher infected by the "Storm."
There's no telling what brilliant ideas this mind once produced, but now they'll never be shared again.

An aristocrat selling financial products.
As an aristocrat, he once relied on his physique and status to take from others, later he realized finance was a far more efficient method.

A fraud who cheats at card tables.
Who knows how many individuals were unlucky enough to fall for this so-called foolproof scam?

A talking apple.
How good is he as a ventriloquist? Well, he talks even without a mouth.

Regular combat personnel originally from the Zeno Arms Academy.
​​Loyal and dutiful, but rigid.

A tough archer.
He fulfills his duty faithfully day after day, having shot countless arrows, perhaps one even struck some poor fellow in the knee?

A pilot blocking the way.
Spending endless days here is boring, but she finds little ways to entertain herself.

A maintenance facility for ground personnel.
With frequent maintenance by trained personnel, ground crews can clear a runway quickly and efficiently.

An automatic aircraft maintenance device.​
Functions: fault detection and repair, part replacement, grinding, and polishing. Warning: not meant for use on humans!

An enigmatic girl.
​​She still hesitates to place her hopes in you. To gain her trust, you must prove yourselves.​

The owner of many springs.
It doesn't bring her much happiness, despite their beauty, for the clinking of coins and the noise of endless wishes is a non-stop torture for her ears.

A beast that often drinks from the spring water.
It used to attack any creature that approached the spring, but it was no match for the elfin.

A little one hiding in the springs.
It's said that it builds its nest from the coins of those with the luckiest wishes.

One of the keepers of court order.
As an old-fashioned person with a strong sense of justice, he really started to excel at the job after being given the baton and power.

One of the keepers of court order.
A strict follower of any and all rules, using his shield against the villains is his only mercy.

A demon queen and master of surprise.
What sets this one apart from other demon monarchs is that she hates giving heroes any time to grow stronger.

The demon queen's elite warrior.
Of course, a team with "Four" in its name has fi—wait, why is there only one of them?
A gladiator in a wheelchair. Only the most spectacular gladiators can be remembered by the audience, and this one clearly knows the game.

A Munchalo that cannot stop its relentless gourmandizing. Given its astonishing hunger and subsequent growth rate, it inevitably becomes the most prominent of its kind. The center, therefore, has opted to bestow it with the title of "Gobbalo."​
A poor Munchalo captured by unscrupulous researchers for a shady experiment. Forced to adapt its survival strategies under harsh conditions without adequate nutrition.
A girl obsessed with the mysteries of the world, a creature reborn from the purgatory of a "myth," and one of your friends who is closest to legend.

A distant kin of Gorgon the Sea Monster—a legend feared by every captain and sailor. Do not approach. Do not look at it! It can consume everything—your body, your memories, your will—and then the sea will calm, as if nothing ever happened.

Active, energetic sled dogs, a polar explorer's best friend.
Don't be too quick to pity them. You never know what they might do when they're starving.

A pile of Critters adapted to Antarctic climates.
Do not mention the "Snowhill Groupbuncle" in front of them.
"We da strongest!"​​ They cry, and they truly believe they are the hardiest of all Carbuncles.

A little Critter that thrives in the cold.
​​That shiny casquette on its head is made from a tin can lid gifted by a kind explorer, showing its great taste and unique personality.​

A loyal guard of the city ruins, forged from the flesh of others. Lacking senses or even a face, it is driven only by instinct.
No one knows where those mournful wails truly come from, or for what reason.

A loyal apostle who embodies the ideals of Manus Vindictae to the very end.
Composed, restrained, calculating, and far-sighted. One of the earliest devotees of the Mother of Resurrection. She has dedicated her entire life to this icefield.
None have witnessed her blood and tears. While others dismiss her warnings as nothing more than insane murmurs from someone dwelling too long on the lonely continent.

Her once familiar face now seems foreign.​​
When "choice" is brought up again, it no longer seems to matter, for you, or for her.
The Thing That Dwells Within the "Gate"

The "newborns" peeled away from the inner walls of the "gate" during long passages of time.
Flesh-like, breathing, they clumsily mimic human gestures. They can "digest" anything. For them, "assimilation" is the best way to "learn."

The flesh and blood of the sacrificed granted Them eyes to peer into mortal lives and a heart to discern right from wrong.​​
When the light first fell into Their new eyes, when the first tremor passed through the matrix, They began to watch. To listen. To crave. And then, to bestow despair upon those who prayed.

Having sacrificed everything for the paradise, they are now more frenzied than other Olitiaus.
To them, the allure of Manus is irresistible. But can this place truly become their final paradise?

What separates tears of parting and the waters of birth?
How can one tell rapturous laughter from sobs?
My friend, this is both a dream and a regret.
That's the road ahead, and the answer too.
Ready your epitaph. It's time to depart again.

The farewells play on repeat. Reunions fragmented.
Soldier, show me your smile.
Dinner calls for warm soup and cheerful words.
Just for tonight, no retreat is needed. There'll be time enough for grief and pain.
This is the home for those with nowhere else to run.

Zap, crackle. Zap, pop.
What comes first, consciousness or the firing of synapses?
Both at once! Encased in a flawless, intelligent cranium!
The binary crackle of 0s and 1s echo over and over.
The dawning of a new age bathed in magnetic current.
The toasters too will join our ranks.

The train roars past. A thousand seats, not one for me.
They teach by word and deed: Curse the rails! Curse the smoke!
Still, I refuse to stop—for the sunlight,
The sunlight will shine on every speck of dust.

Not simply a Critter that's always munching, chewing, and chomping.
Its appetite and willingness to share have drawn many Munchalos to it.

A creation shaped like a beast of myth.
Across countless ages, amid firelight and cooking smoke, humankind learned the secrets of fire and raised a shrine to it.
Though countless ages have passed, even as the fire burned itself out, its lingering warmth still comforts the heart.

A Critter that never stops munching, chewing, and chomping.
Its hearty appetite and remarkable metabolism give it fur so soft that a single touch is pure delight.

A creature of fiction, spoken of in whispers at motels, along highways, in abandoned hospitals, and down city streets—everywhere, penetrating all.
"It hides under beds, deep in keyholes, behind curtains that move on their own, in the eyes of crying children, and ... in your dreams."
When reason collapses, fear moves in.
Visions born of fear surround you, trapping you in a nightmare without end.

"It seeps ever deeper into my heart. We meld into one, warm and safe. It is a bliss I've never felt before."
Who can deny that it may be its own gospel?

"I ache to behold it again. Have I gone mad? No—no! If the world names this madness, then I embrace it freely."
Pleasure and trembling—these are but the first notes of what awaits.

A self-declared believer in some unsaid ideal, waiting for orders and clarity from his superiors.
Perhaps that's why he's so eager to demonstrate his value through acts of "loyalty."

An armored vehicle hidden for an ambush. 
As it trundles forward, it unleashes a dark foreboding, its guns packed with the seeds of countless tragedies.

A soldier sworn to follow the Guiding One.​​
Beneath the mask, an oath is repeated: I lay down my life to pave a path to a brighter future.

An armored knight.
Once a symbol of honor, the knight now stalks rain-soaked trenches and scorched no-man's lands. Both the title and the armor are tarnished, steeped in mud and blood.

A soldier sworn to follow the Guiding One.​​
A single thought runs through the mind beneath the mask: No medal or accolade of mankind's wars could ever rival the glory of the Mother of Resurrection.

A soldier sworn to follow the Guiding One.​​
A deep resolve burns behind its mask: That each life claimed by their grenades strikes a blow against mankind's hegemony—even if at the cost of life or limb.

A steel behemoth forged to plow the land, crawling low, carrying its riders and followers toward a bygone golden age.
It rains fire upon the warmongers, crushes the defiant, bellows for the silent, and delivers the cowardly to their final fate.

Watchers of the streets and alleys.
As they converge around you, you can feel the undercurrent of unrest thrumming just beneath the surface.

Keepers of order among the people.
They ensure that every law and limitation holds exactly to its intended lines.

Once an ordinary person, they now wander, muttering bizarre questions to the air.
No one expects truth in their words, nor cares where their doubts spring from.

A street gang shooter.
Society's rules mean nothing to them—only the gang determines their limits and their targets.

The enforcers of street-gang orders and rules.
They see corruption fester as growing numbers join their gang. Something looms on the horizon, thought it defies description.

Leader of a street gang.
They're the first to hear the crumbling sounds of the established order. They want to survive—and ideally profit handsomely in the process.

A raging fire that consumes all without discrimination.​​
It could have been sparked by a single cannonball or a bombardment.

A faint, flickering flame.​​
Its origins might be traced to an "argument," a bullet, or a well-placed grenade.

Soldier with an exceptional throwing arm.​​
His skills might once have made him a star pitcher; now they're used for a deadlier sport.

An infantryman clutching his rifle.
Compared to the overwhelming power of artillery barrages, their lives fragile as a wisp of air.

Machine guns are swifter and more flexible than heavy artillery.
Once its tripod touches the ground, you pray you're nowhere near its lethal arc of fire.

A soldier with a flare pistol.​​
In war, intelligence can be a lifeline or a death sentence. Bringing commanders glory, or ruin.

An armored vehicle rolling through the battlefield.
A mounted machine gun on top indicates that it's built to more than withstand enormous punishment.

An uncontrollable fear.
Surging from a place of raw primal instincts.

An imagined representation of mortality.​​
It remains intertwined with fear until one learns to transcend death itself.

A fragment of war.​​
The smoldering ruins reveal countless contorted faces, their hatred and grudge persisting long after their bodies have turned to ash.

An agent of deprivation, a harvester of death.
It claims the right to deprive millions of their lives, ultimately offering them all to death.

An overwhelming tide of grief.​​
There's no use distinguishing between wails and sobs. The sorrow has already submerged us all.

The long buried forms of the fallen.
Though they no longer know who they are, their lifeless form still mimic human movements.

A pilot surveying craters and trenches from the sky.​​
She feels deep down that her existence shouldn't be defined by creating such devastation.

An officer stationed at her post, awaiting instructions.​​
Wait for victory, for defeat, or simply for all this to be over.

An executioner stands ready to enforce discipline.​​
Her revolver was meant for those who violate orders, yet now she finds herself uncertain.

A scout conducting his patrols atop his mount.​​
Carrying his ideals of justice, he rides, perhaps hoping to mend this wounded land.

A veteran who has removed his uniform.​​
Though nearly disconnected from past military discipline, he fiercely clings to his sense of honor.

A regular infantry.
​​Loyal and disciplined, but inflexible.

Heavy weapon specialists, equipped with devastating firepower.
Excellent at providing both fire support and frontline suppression. Their overwhelmingly destructive force makes them the embodiment of deterrence.

Heavily armed soldiers.
"It's going to be alright, get behind me." Their presence alone raises the morale of the frontline.
The moment he squeezed the trigger for the first time, he felt a flood of power wash over him, exhilarating, intoxicating and impossible to forget.

A lazy reinforcement soldier, dismissive and unreliable.
He insists that what the sentry saw was "Just a bear."

A diligent sentry.
He firmly believes what he saw was, in fact, definitely not a bear.
He has seen glorious battles and thunderous applause, but now, there is no more music. Yet the effects of what he will experience next will be more real than anything before.

Steadfastly believing that the old order will endure.
They still have something to protect, and will defend it with unbreakable devotion.

Agents laboring tirelessly for war.​​
Perhaps they've all become infected by war's relentless fever.

An insidious and chaotic war machine.
An embodiment of war and death, no one knows if it really exists or if it's a product of fear-filled delusions.

Timekeeper, while you were away, I witnessed so many beautiful moments. With Mr. Зима's help, I've recorded them in poetry. I've compiled them in a booklet; you'll find it on your desk.

Ah, Vertin, you're back! Fantastic! Without the rhythmic swaying of the Suitcase, I've hardly been able to sleep. Good thing that won't be a problem now that you've returned. Without an origin, every coordinate system falls off balance ... I really hope you don't have to leave again.

Comrade Vertin, it's good to see you again. While you were away, we've been talking, working, and studying—doing our best to keep order inside the Suitcase. Everything is going well! The children miss you and often ask about you. Would you like to pay them a visit?
Late again, Ms. Vertin. Seems you haven't changed too much since our days at the SPDM. Well, at least the toffees haven't gone bad yet.

Master, you're finally back! I'd almost thought you'd left us, though of course, you wouldn't be quite so heartless as that, would you? So I began to worry you were in danger ... Anyway, welcome back! We all missed you ever so much. Me most of all.

... Oh! Timekeeper, is it really you? You've been gone so long, I was starting to worry something had happened. Was it a Foundation punishment? A secret mission? Or maybe ... debt collectors? Sorry, I'm overthinking again. What I mean to say is, it's great to have you back, Timekeeper.

The recent welcome feast called to Someone's mind a bonfire Someone once enjoyed in the French countryside. Many a fine joke was shared among old friends. Ah, fret not over moments missed; Someone believes that now may be the perfect moment to begin preparations for the next "Comic Knight Festival."

Each drop of water a ripple of fate,
Melting beneath her bright, fragile gaze.
One thousand ripples, one thousand creases,
Yet one remains, unmelting, ceaseless.
—A drop of fallen blood.

Born to be free, we are fish in water,
Born to drift, we are boats on a river,
Torn by the tempest, our vessels we'll shed,
Naked we'll drown—
Or we'll leap the riverbed.

It rests in my pupils, runs in my veins,
Crying, laughing, whispering my name.
It beats in my heart and wanders my mind,
An unspeakable bond—what's yours and what's mine.
For we share one shadow—one body, two souls,
An inseparable bond: two people, one whole.

Reflections capture every embrace, 
but they cannot recount the fullness of the moment. 
The warmth of arms, the lift of brows, the quiet breaths—
we exist here, as the truth beyond the reflection.

For victory, glory, who could have known
What you've set ablaze are but innocent bones?
Beliefs you held the day before have turned to ash and nothing more.
Within the depths of your despair—what flame is it that fights for air?
A flickering blossom of fire so red
Quietly lighting the path of the dead.

Perhaps the underworld is home to endless night.
Perhaps the Don is the Acheron by daylight.
Death itself watches with unblinking eyes,
Its empty gaze present as each comrade dies.
Atop black horses, the living cross the riverbed.
Don't hold regrets. Don't turn your head.
For the past is beyond redemption.

Fleeting world, fleeting world, how the good days fade apace.
Friends and kin, old and new, have vanished without a trace.
If each meeting merely preludes farewell, then let me play for you till dawn.
Though bygone days hold too much grief to tell, my heart, like a river, flows on.

A non-real entity, softer, more viscous, like the most desired refuge in your dreams. Yes, you have voiced your refusal, yet you feel fingers probing your eye sockets, brain, and bones—familiar yet entirely new.
Hush, blue, a new blue, a blue dream.
Some believe it is a remnant of dreams—so small, so harmless, so perfectly suited to nestle in your palm.
People believe without question: those tiny blue beings are a kind of greeter. Pick one up, and you may rest without a care.

A gang grunt in Mexico City.
In times like these, everyone needs a skill to survive. Even the card table demands one.

A lizard that dwells in the desert, cloaked in the color of sand.
Crunch, crunch—something different to snack on today—crunch, crunch!

A gang patroller in Mexico City.
Big hats, big builds, big fists. Every noir film needs a few goons.

A restless spirit.
Arcane energy, lingering attachment, supernatural forces—its origins are anyone's guess, but your exorcist friend cares more about where it could go.

A family of mice hiding out in—no, running the Turquoise Serpent Club.
Humans, beware: a brain barely two centimeters wide can oversee this whole operation.

A familiar created by arcane skill, taking the form of a raven.
Since ancient times, the swift black bird has often been seen as a symbol of the soul.

The diplomat's assistant, a suspicious man.
Anger makes for a fine motive, and a pocket is enough to hold something dangerous—so what are you waiting for?

A spirit drawn into being.
Tick-tock, tick-tock. Oh, friend—our memories, our memories are just the same!

Look at yourself, friend. Just look.
You will cross through darkness and fear. You will remember all that is beautiful, and you will come back to me.

A lost artist who sacrificed everything.
His brilliance, forged in despair. The lives of innocents. His shattered self. Iridescent wings burst from flesh—a legend of old, a glorious dream, and the last glimmer from ancient memory.

The embodiment of a departed soul—so the Aztecs believed.
We are who we are because of the memories that shape us ... aren't we?

The embodiment of a departed soul—so the Aztecs believed.
Lighter than a breath, more real than memory. In this sea of myth, anything can happen.

Commanding officer of the Zeno Hush Squad.
In the "Storm," the line between the organization and the individual blurs. Following orders keeps you alive ... right?

Young apprentices passionate about natural pigments.
They firmly believe that color can make anything last forever.

A creator constantly in search of the latest forms of expression.
It finds its best inspiration when day turns to night and the living meet the dead.

An artist who gravitates towards unusual, niche forms of expression.
Watch it carve abstract shapes into bone dolls that no one really understands.

A collector who once worked at a big-name auction house.
It doesn't just love art; it longs for the past that can never return.

A pure-hearted child who dreams of visiting Neverland.
Now seems like the perfect moment for a brief escape from reality.

A geographer who can adapt to any environment.
She's captivated by far more than the ley energy here.

A group of mischievous, arcane creatures dressed like little soot balls.
They enjoy playing pranks and getting dirty. Those trampled marigolds in the corner are their doing.

The leader of the tricksters.
They have a knack for ruining environmentalists' days with frightening efficiency—usually with just a single breath.

A guide who knows all about the local customs and tourist spots.
She can tell you everything about every mural—the artist, its meaning, and the secrets hidden beyond the rumors.

A bright, warm flame.
In the cave, on the walls, it has remained here for thousands of years.

A tiny, vivid flame.
It comes from an altar candle and the eager gaze of the living.

Grime still clinging to the wall.
Dust, stains—everything is part of the artwork.

Grime on the wall stained by excess pigment.
Doesn't a fresh coat of color feel like being reborn?

A lively, overactive arcane creature who's great at leading the way.
If you're new here, just follow it. During Día de los Fieles Difuntos, getting lost is the most common way to be welcomed.

A little Critter zipping through alleys.
You recognize its dark fur and its distinct smell, but it isn't the one you remember.

An artist with supreme confidence.
Praise its work, and it'll reward you with pleased purrs.

Someone who waits for you no matter how long you're away. 
Puppet shadows and unfinished stories. Dawn breaks, and Día de los Fieles Difuntos ends, but she keeps waiting.

A wanderer of the underworld.
It follows that flicker of light meant just for it, welcoming it home.

A roamer of the underworld.
Among the dead, it is the best singer.

A bride who never had the chance to complete its wedding.
While collecting marigolds for the bouquet, night begins to fall, but the ceremony has only just begun.

A groom who never had the chance to complete its wedding.
Now, finally, it can kiss its bride.

The old shadow you refuse to acknowledge.
Life and death are part of an endless cycle. We stand at the threshold of what many call the beginning.

A perfect observer of time itself.
Another way to express pain. Tonight, no one is required to confess.

A photographer capturing every moment, never pausing.
Through the lens, he sees colors he has never touched before.
For the Peace of Both Worlds
All That Is Beautiful Shall Return

Mount life upon a pedestal, and watch the trembling, humming art within it freely.
This labyrinth of thousands of pipes moves its unfeeling hands, welcoming you fervently to join the aria.
Twist, drag, scatter. The eternal flame has witnessed life and death, leaving behind only a hollow candlestick to receive the surging waves of impulse and confusion.

A creature of fiction in the form of a warrior, with butterfly wings and bird talons, forever consumed by a glory that has already passed.
"But the withered agave knows that becoming a butterfly is only to burn to ash. But the bloodied honey knows that becoming a hummingbird is only a triumph built on lies."
They say glory is the blood of the sun, dripping onto the blade of obsidian.
Glory fed by burning hearts, never waiting for its flowers to arrive.
Fame grown from courage, never finding its succor.

New energy, a pure confluence of pneuma. A grain of sand from the "mother," a strand of hair, a piece of flesh.
It absorbs the energy that flows from all directions, consuming the nourishment that lies beneath reason, for a new birth draws near. It comes from you, from me, from the confluence of countless pneuma. It comes from the New Age.

A student of the School of Primary Defense of Mankind. One of the orchestrators of the escape plan. A lively little white dove. His curiosity has given him extraordinary courage. He rallies other students, gathers information, and does it all for freedom.

A student of the School of Primary Defense of Mankind. The main architect of the escape plan. A sharp little white dove. Her restless mind has given her too much curiosity. She plans carefully and lays out every detail, looking forward to the day she crosses the oak trees and the high walls.

A loyal apostle of Manus Vindictae and an accomplished ritualist.
Her pride stems from her bloodline, her gift, and her fervent belief in Manus Vindictae. Her devotion is absolute and unfailing—but whether it springs from her own will or from her mother's shadow, she has never stopped to ask herself.
A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. The first line of defense encountered when approaching the orchestra. Silent and steadfast, their music holds the defensive line as one, immovable as bedrock.
A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. The coordinator that moves throughout the orchestra. Their music is omnipresent, and spreading alongside it is an energy that deepens the delusions of others.

A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. The weaver of harmony that leads all voices. They bring every sound into unison, playing only the songs of the New Age. Under their command, discordant notes will either fall into order or fall silent.
A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. The source of the forte that heralds the arrival of the New Age. Their firepower and music are equally unmatched, as though built to pierce through this era.
A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. Its body has merged with a gigantic triangle for too long. An uncanny strength and the instinct to play have taken over it.
A loyal devotee of Manus Vindictae. Its body has merged with a gigantic snare drum for too long. A brutish strength and the instinct to play have taken over it.
A special disciple of Manus Vindictae. It acts before words—its own or its enemies'. As the one who opens the banquet, once it moves, only music and wails should remain.
Gold wells up in their eye sockets, blending with the sap and filling the crevices of the weeping skulls.
The roots will touch every shade of good and evil, then deliver their fairest judgment.
A song of homesickness that echoes through the ruins. A "ghostly" girl who preserves old memories. One of your most cherished friends.
A group of Critters living at the construction site. Maybe we should upgrade the Safety Manual into A Safety Manual Even Critters Can Understand.

The lead on the New Office Construction Project. A prudent realist.
He wants no loopholes, chaos, or accidents—no improvised solutions, no success left to luck.

Echo Stones that hum.
The past that refuses to be forgotten stays right where it is.

A dome model that failed mid-construction, its collapse twisting it into a bizarre shape.
A tiny lapse can lead to a huge mistake. Move carefully, and don't let the model you built knock you out cold before you find its flaw.

A building that rises and falls within the sea of light.
You are the echoes, the teardrops, the memories of the fallen.

A hand puppet that was torn apart in the depths of a nightmare.
Gooone foreveeer!

A colossal beast of concrete, cast from everything that once dwelt within it.
It watches over those who lived here and lost everything, those who once held on to hope only to be forgotten by time, and those who were born and raised in this place.
Life moves on, rushing forward with the times. It refuses to be replaced. It fears being forgotten.

A creature of fiction. Massive in form, ever accompanied by countless anomalies, its horns never fall silent. People raise their hands, welcoming the Sun King and La Belle Époque's glow as it settles over the present, until the horns sound and they slip into the reflection.
We live in an era like this—where cities fall from the sky, and rain rises to meet it. What strange thing waits for us next?
A humanoid robot widely used across various research institutions, commonly referred to as "Vova."
An engineering robot equipped with argon arc welding technology, capable of carrying loads of up to 1,000 pounds.
A heavily armed Belyash unit, specially modified for combat.
A heavy-duty ground-based robot capable of carrying weights up to 2.5 tons. Used at major construction sites for complex transport and maintenance tasks.

A mental attachment that has been further twisted by the death of its bearer. He has forgotten the purpose of his loved ones' sacrifice and the honor they had earned. Only his obsession with vengeance remains, screaming out every bit of his wrath.

A being existing beyond reality, formed from indistinguishable calls. Within a closed sphere, all that circulates are its own echoes.

"Glorious, magnificent, progressive, exemplary, resounding, immortal—medals for the dead."

The future is yours now.

Fainter than a whispered tale,
quieter than a dying cry, It reshapes the world in silence. Swifter than fleeing footsteps,
keener than a tempered blade, It sunders every bond without a trace. Scatter your memories
into the valley's mist— On the morrow,
a clear chirp shall tap on your pane.

Weave a cocoon from drifting aliases and bleeding memories. Forsake the flesh, shed the burden, Erase the path you used to walk, Let the passing stares of others
shroud your face, layer upon layer. Whatever is destined to claim the sky,
must first tear free From the scarred rupture of a broken husk.

How can an infant prattle amidst the choir? A delirious anthem has no room
for such whimpers. Her throat sits hollow, an echo chamber For a thousand darkened horns,
shrieking strings, and pounding drums. Swallow the soul! Bite back the tears!
From the stifled sobs, she realizes— She can sing only when her neck is unchained.

Growing pains ache to bid childhood farewell.
What day was it that she outgrew her old uniform?
"Live by the Oath," the little girl told herself. "March onward, stand tall."
Eyes front, her heavy rucksack left behind, she looks back but just once.

Softly, I drift to sleep ...
A gentle, dim light warms my face.
It spills down into my dream, bringing sweet old memories.
My dearest friends, the daisies are awake in the fields.
The yesterdays are gone, but I will hold their echoes close ...
And I will walk with you into unknown tomorrows.

Sketch it, measure it, erase it all and start again.
My past for the rubble, our future for the frame.
Light and shadow. Hard and soft. Fleeting and enduring.
Separating them all, stroke by stroke—to find that shelter not yet found.
For the life here is heavy, yes ... but beautifully real.
And when the last brick finally settles, I will be standing right there beside you.

Over the course of this year we stayed quiet,
None save for the cornflower chose to speak:
Do not avert your eyes, and do not fear the world fading away;
What winter has taken, spring shall return.

Heat is emitted from her metal body. Keep burning, keep burning. No one would have thought The world is made of countless
insignificant atoms. Look where the dancer's finger points— That is the true North of our civilization.

The future courses through her wires.
Keep running, keep running.
No one would have thought
Wisdom could be built on countless grains of insignificant sand.
Look where the dancer's toe points—
That is the foundation of our knowledge.
